The **Amalgamation** is a massive flesh-golem construct created by the [[Brotherhood]] to serve as the eternal guardian of the [[Grand Archive]].

## Nature and Construction
Constructed from the preserved flesh and sinew of deceased Brotherhood members, the Amalgamation is a patchwork entity nearly ten feet tall. It lacks sensory organs and navigates its environment through an exquisite sensitivity to vibration, sound, and air pressure. The magical darkness that permeates the Brotherhood sanctum is its natural environment, and its prolonged presence intensifies this darkness.

## Capabilities and Programming
The Amalgamation follows its last given orders: to guard the archives and destroy unauthorized intruders. It is immune to spells of 6th level or lower that require a saving throw. When damaged, it enters a rage state, moving faster and striking harder. It is vulnerable to radiant damage, which disrupts the necromantic bindings that animate it. A specific command phrase—*"Stand Guardian. The Brotherhood commands it."*—can cause it to pause for a short time, but this only works once per encounter.

## History
The Amalgamation has patrolled the dark halls of the Grand Archive for two centuries, awaiting intruders or a return of its creators that never came.
